artifact_observations.reasoning: There are faint, raised markings on the white sidewall of the tire that attempt to mimic brand lettering but resolve into nonsensical, melted shapes upon close inspection. This is a classic generative artifact.

The blue emblem in the very center of the wheel lacks geometric definition. It appears as a smeared blue blob rather than a distinct manufacturer logo, suggesting a failure to render fine structural details.
Some of the inner spokes seem to merge slightly awkwardly with the outer barrel of the rim, lacking precise mechanical separation, though this is subtle.

To specifically analyze the illegible markings on the tire sidewall to confirm if they constitute text gibberish artifacts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tire sidewall. AI models often struggle with rendering coherent text on curved surfaces like tires. If the text auditor finds only noise or melted glyphs, this is a significant artifact. Also, inspect the center cap logo; if it is an undefined blob, it indicates a lack of fine-grained structural understanding. Ensure the 'bolt holes' are evaluated critically—are they actual holes or just decorative bumps?
